verified_facts: timestamped DTM archive contains surveys since 1998
tiles are GeoTIFF in 5km zip files
elevations are metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
timestamped LIDAR vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE
transformation is specific to survey time period
ground truth points have +/-3cm RMSE accuracy
ground truth can be reused under age rules
LIDAR QC requires less than +/-15cm RMSE and 10cm standard deviation/random error
quality_effect: Adds survey-time, vertical-datum and independent ground-truth gates so old or mismatched local LIDAR cannot silently inflate candidate confidence.
